item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02440","case1_error":"Correctly writes 14 × 60 but evaluates Anna's candy total as 252 instead of 840.","case2_error":"Treats all three initial packs as given away, although Antonov gave his sister only one pack.","reason":"The first miscalculates a correctly specified product; the second incorrectly identifies the quantity given away.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02441","case1_error":"Treats 90 seconds per ear as 90 seconds for the whole cat, omitting the second ear.","case2_error":"Selects Day 4 despite calculating eight miles, below the ten-mile threshold; also misstates percentages of the first day's distance.","reason":"The first omits a required multiplicity; the second selects a day that fails its stated threshold.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02442","case1_error":"Subtracts car spending directly from the console price instead of subtracting available savings from that price.","case2_error":"Counts four weeks as four weekdays and uses only two weekend days for the month.","reason":"The first confuses spending with available savings; the second incorrectly converts calendar periods into counts of earning days, even under its assumptions.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02443","case1_error":"Uses an incorrect conversion factor of 1.16 ounces per pound instead of 16.","case2_error":"Divides the full weekly requirement by five elapsed days, ignoring consumption already completed and the two remaining days.","reason":"The first uses an incorrect unit conversion; the second forms the daily requirement from the wrong amount and time interval.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02444","case1_error":"Uses the first day's total of 50 flowers as its tulip count, counting those 20 roses again as tulips.","case2_error":"Eight descending intervals are valid if ground is floor 1; nine apply if ground is floor 0. Floor numbering is unspecified.","reason":"The first clearly substitutes a total for a category count. The second depends on an unstated floor-numbering convention, so its mathematical error is ambiguous.","judgment":"uncertain"}]}
